errors.evidence: The chart contains eight slices, not six as stated. The categories are: 体育 (4%), 社会 (20%), 榜样 (19%), 政治 (6%), 文化 (14%), 经济 (2%), 科学 (21%), and 环境保护 (14%).
The description omits two categories shown in the legend and chart: 科学 (Science) and 环境保护 (Environmental Protection).
The blue slice for 体育 (Sports) is 4%, not 21%. The 21% slice is dark blue and corresponds to 科学 (Science).
The green slice for 政治 (Politics) is 6%, not 14%.
The slice for 文化 (Culture) is teal/light green, not pink. The pink slice represents 经济 (Economy) at 2%.
The slice for 经济 (Economy) is pink and has a value of 2%, not 6%. There is no purple slice. The 6% slice is green and represents 政治 (Politics).
The description hallucinates a category called '水平色' (horizontal color). There is no such category in the chart.
The category '环境保护' (Environmental Protection) has a value of 14%, not 4%.

errors.text_span: 切片按照它们在较粗大到较小的大小排序
errors.evidence: The slices are not sorted by size. For example, the largest slice (21%) is next to one of the smallest (2%).

errors.text_span: 同时图表中的切片也未直线排列
errors.evidence: This phrase, which translates to 'the slices in the chart are not arranged in a straight line', is nonsensical for a pie chart and adds confusion.
